unlicensedOrders.title: Paid orders without a licence
unlicensedOrders.description: Licence orders that Polar reports as paid and that have no licence here, usually because the customer matches no account. The Licences page of the docs describes how to recover one.
unlicensedOrders.empty: Every paid licence order has its licence

licenses.title: Licences by tier
licenses.description: Every licence in the database, counted by tier and status. An active licence works in the CLI; a refunded or revoked one no longer does.
